born 14 April 2006) is an [[Israel]]i professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Brooklyn Nets]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). ==Early life== Saraf is Jewish and was born to Israeli parents in South Africa, where his father worked in the diamond industry.{{cite web |last1=Cohen |first1=Haley Ben Saraf and Danny Wolf selected in the first round of the NBA draft; Wednesday night marked the first time since 2006 that two Jewish players were picked in the same draft |url=https://jewishinsider.com/2025/06/danny-wolf-ben-saraf-nba-draft-basketball-jewish/ |website=Jewish Insider |date=27 June 2025}}{{cite web |last1=Amorban |first1=Efrat |title=Ben Saraf's exciting and fateful week - Israeli player could be headed to the NBA |url=https://www.ynetnews.com/culture/article/sycxhnunel |website=Ynetnews |access-date=29 June 2025 |date=24 June 2025}} The family returned to Israel when Saraf was three. Saraf grew up in [[Moshav]] [[Gan Yoshiya]] in the [[Emek Hefer Regional Council]] in Israel. His father Yedid played one season for [[Bnei Herzliya Basket]] in the Israeli Basketball Premier League. His mother, Ella Amir Sharaf, grew up in [[Kibbutz]] [[Givat Haim]] and played basketball for the Israeli men’s national team and for a number of years in Israel’s second basketball division.{{cite web|url=https://www-one-co-il.translate.goog/Article/425353.html?_x_tr_sl=iw&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en&_x_tr_pto=sc | title=Meet Ben Sharaf, the next diamond in Israeli basketball | work=one-co | date=24 December 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www-ynet-co-il.translate.goog/article/rj11ss1npf?_x_tr_sl=iw&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en&_x_tr_pto=sc&_x_tr_hist=true|title=After Avdiya: The 15-year-old Israeli talent you must know |work=Ynet|date=25 January 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.ynetnews.com/culture/article/sycxhnunel | title=Ben Saraf's exciting and fateful week - Israeli player could be headed to the NBA | work=Ynet News | date=24 June 2025}} He attended Ramot Yam Emek Hefer high school. ==Professional career== Saraf began his professional career at 16 years old playing for [[Elitzur Netanya B.C.|Elitzur Netanya]] in the second division [[Israeli Basketball National League]]. He averaged 14 points, 3.3 rebounds, and three assists per game during the [[2022–23 Israeli Basketball National League|2022–23 season]].{{cite web|url=https://www.ynet.co.il/sport/article/sydpi2b8c|title=התקווה הישראלית בדראפט 2026 :תוכן גולשים|first=Ziv|last=Narkis|website=[[Ynet.com]]|date=25 June 2024|access-date=18 September 2024|language=Hebrew}} In April 2023, he was named the National League's Sixth Player of the Season and Rookie of the Year.{{cite web|url=https://www-sport5-co-il.translate.goog/articles.aspx?FolderID=1379&docID=434382&_x_tr_sl=iw&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en&_x_tr_pto=sc/|title=Eitan Borg is the national player of the season, Ben Sharaf is the sixth player |work=Sport5|date=10 April 2023}} He signed with [[Elitzur Kiryat Ata]] of the top division [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]] on 11 July 2023.{{cite web|url=https://www.sport5.co.il/articles.aspx?FolderID=274&docID=442593|title=עולה לליגת העל: בן שרף חתם בקריית אתא|first=Noa|last=Poplinger|website=[[Sports Channel (Israel)|Sports Channel]]|date=11 July 2023|access-date=18 September 2024|language=Hebrew}} After averaging 10.7 points, 3.2 rebounds, 3.7 assists, and one steal per game in 2023–24, Saraf was named the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League Rising Star]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/with-ratiopharm-ulm-ben-saraf-is-in-the-perfect-environment|title=With Ratiopharm Ulm, Ben Saraf Is in the Perfect Environment|first=Andrew|last=Bernucca|website=[[SI.com]]|date=17 September 2024|access-date=18 September 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.sport5.co.il/articles.aspx?FolderID=274&docID=471656|title=בן שרף נבחר לתגלית העונה, גיא פלטין שחקן ההגנה|website=[[Sports Channel (Israel)|Sports Channel]]|date=30 May 2024|access-date=18 September 2024|language=Hebrew}} Saraf signed with [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL) in Germany on 20 June 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/eurocup/news/ulm-invests-in-teenage-sensation-ben-saraf/|title=Ulm invests in teenage sensation Ben Saraf|website=EuroleagueBasketball.net|date=20 June 2024|access-date=18 September 2024}} At Ulm, he played for coach [[Ty Harrelson]] and had a major role on the team, which reached the Bundesliga finals.{{Cite web |date=11 June 2025 |title=Next Big Thing: Can Ben Saraf be the next breakout star? |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025/news/next-big-thing-can-ben-saraf-be-the-next-breakout-star |access-date=27 June 2025 |website=FIBA |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=18 June 2025 |title=Next Big Thing: Noa Essengue continues rise of future French stars |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025/news/next-big-thing-noa-essengue-continues-rise-of-future-french-stars |access-date=27 June 2025 |website=FIBA |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=21 June 2025 |title=Saraf and Jessup shine as Ulm steals homecourt advantage from Bayern |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/bbl/1840025/bayern-versus-ulm-bbl-finals-game-3-germany/ |access-date=27 June 2025 |website=Eurohoops.net}} He averaged 12.8 points and 4.6 assists per game in 2024–25. Saraf was selected by the [[Brooklyn Nets]] with the 26th pick in the [[2025 NBA draft]] on 25 June 2025, side-by-side with American-Israeli [[Danny Wolf]], who was selected with the 27th pick. This marked the first time that two Israeli players were picked by the same team in the [[National_Basketball_Association|NBA]] draft.[https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-hoopsters-ben-saraf-danny-wolf-taken-by-nets-in-first-round-of-nba-draft/ “Israeli hoopsters Ben Saraf, Danny Wolf taken by Nets in first round of NBA draft,”] ''The Times of Israel''. Before then, three Israelis were drafted in the NBA draft and played in the NBA: [[Omri Casspi]], [[T. J. Leaf]], and [[Deni Avdija]]. He received a guaranteed two-year contract, for $2.4 million in his rookie season and $2.52 million in his second season.{{cite web|url=https://www-ynet-co-il.translate.goog/sport/worldbasketball/article/ryeksdyneg?_x_tr_sl=iw&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en&_x_tr_pto=sc&_x_tr_hist=true | title=Two more Israelis in the NBA - on a historic night: Ben Sharaf and Danny Wolf were selected by Brooklyn in the draft | work=Ynet | date=25 June 2025}} On 15 December 2025, Saraf was assigned to the Nets' G League affiliate, the [[Long Island Nets]].{{cite web |title=Nets' Ben Saraf: Assigned to G League |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/nets-ben-saraf-assigned-to-g-league-508710/ |website=[[CBS Sports]] |access-date=17 December 2025 |date=16 December 2025}} ==National team career== Saraf played for the [[Israel men's national under-16 basketball team|Israel under-16 basketball team]] in the [[2022 FIBA U16 European Championship]]. He led the tournament in scoring with 24.3 points per game and was named to the 2022 European U16 All-Tournament Team.{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-812442|title=Ben Saraf takes leadership role for blue-and-white at U18 Euros|first=Joshua|last=Halickman|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=30 July 2024|access-date=18 September 2024}} Saraf played for the [[Israel men's national under-18 basketball team|Israel under-18 basketball team]] in the [[2024 FIBA U18 EuroBasket]] Championship.{{cite web|url=https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/sports/article-815523|title=Israel's youth basketball team has successful run|first=Joshua|last=Halickman|work=[[The Jerusalem Post]]|date=20 August 2024|access-date=18 September 2024}} He again led the tournament in scoring, this time with 28.1 points per game, led the tournament in steals with four per game, was named the tournament MVP, and was named to the 2024 European U18 All-Tournament Team, as Israel finished fourth.{{cite web|url=https://www.ynetnews.com/culture/article/rj49wyu9a|title=Israeli basketball player Ben Saraf is poised to reach the NBA|website=[[Ynet.com]]|date=13 August 2024|access-date=18 September 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/ngt/players/ben-saraf/profile/011437/|title=Ben Saraf
